purpose: Teach: 南西/貧弱/粘着/一滴/日照/辺境/罪人/首尾

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、南西諸島周辺の密漁事案を、警察、対応されますね
lines.en: So the police will be handling the illegal fishing case in the southwestern islands, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, methodical opening. Slightly formal register. Even pacing, as if working through a checklist. Genuine curiosity beneath the structural phrasing—not lecturing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の貧弱な体格を踏まえた捜査も慎重にされますね
lines.en: The police will conduct the investigation carefully, given the victim's fragile physical condition, won't they?
lines.style: Steady, measured response. Affirming without being defensive. Clear enunciation on the key terms. Professional but not distant—partnering with the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の粘着テープ、つまり粘着痕の鑑識を、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: So the police will examine the adhesive residue from the scene forensically, won't they?
lines.style: Returning to reflective tone. Slightly slower pace on technical terms. Lean forward subtly with 'adhesive'—the precision matters to him. Genuine collaboration in the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、毒物の一滴でも検出される鑑定もされますね
lines.en: The police will also run analyses that can detect even a single drop of poison, won't they?
lines.style: Firm nod in the voice. Quick, confident delivery on 'poison'—this is within their capability. Reassurance mixed with professional certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯行時の日照状態を、警察、検証されますね
lines.en: So the police will verify the lighting conditions at the time of the crime, won't they?
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Each phrase gets equal weight. The question isn't perfunctory—he's genuinely thinking aloud about what needs checking. Slight rise at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、辺境地域の警備強化もされますね
lines.en: The police will also strengthen security in the remote areas, won't they?
lines.style: Direct, clear response. Forward momentum—this is an actionable point. No hesitation. Practical and committed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、罪人の更生支援を、警察、保護観察と連携されますね
lines.en: So the police will work with probation services on the offender's rehabilitation support, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before starting. Slightly lower volume—awareness that rehabilitation is a longer, quieter work than investigation. Sincere interest in systemic care.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の首尾、つまり首尾一貫性を、警察、保たれますね
lines.en: The police will maintain consistency throughout the investigation from start to finish, won't they?
lines.style: Measured, grounding conclusion. Weight on 'consistency'—the through-line that holds everything together. Quiet conviction. Almost a benediction.
